_notes: Every action number below is verified present in Spongebob.air (see mugenparsertoolkit output). Damage/kbBase/kbGrowth/angle follow character-mapper.html's own CATEGORY_DEFAULTS per slot category (light/medium/smash/air/special), lightly varied for flavor - real MUGEN HitDef damage values (23-55, tuned for a MUGEN health bar) are documented in moveset_enriched.json but intentionally NOT copied 1:1 into this percent-based Smash economy, matching how the engine's existing legacy MOVESETS table already handles the original 6-slot roster. Sounds are real (group,sample) refs pulled from the character's own .cns PlaySnd controllers / HitDef hitSound-guardSound fields; groups with duplicate sample indices in the source .snd (see sound_bank.json) resolve to a random real variant at runtime instead of always the same one.

specialN.label: Krabby Patty Gun
specialN._note: Real flying object per supers.cns Statedef 1000's Helper (stateno 1002, 'Krabby Patty') - anim 1002 is a genuine single-frame patty sprite (group 255,0), spinning as it flies in the source (AngleAdd -15/tick, not replicated here). hitSparkAction 8210 is that same state's own real hitDef sparkno. offsetX/offsetY are the real Helper's own 'pos = 70,-50' (raw sprite-pixel units - the engine multiplies these by the shooter's own render scale before use, same as Clsn boxes, so it spawns from gun height regardless of character size).

specialU.label: Bubble
specialU._note: Real MUGEN Statedef 1200 'Bubble' is a non-damaging floating trap (Helper stateno 1201, real 2-frame sprite group 1300,5) whose HitDef does 0 damage and instead forces the opponent into a separate dizzy state (p2stateno 2150, anim 5300) for ~100 ticks (~1.67s) on contact - its own hitDef sparkno (33000) is genuinely blank (no impact flash), matching that quiet, non-violent intent. Reinterpreted here as SpongeBob's Up-B: the vertical recovery movement (sweep block below) is kept as a gameplay necessity (Smash needs every character to have a recovery option), but the on-hit effect now matches the real move - 0 damage, no knockback, no spark, just the real stun/dizzy lock (engine's Character.applyStun(), pose 'dizzy' = action 5300) for stunDuration seconds. A follow-up hit from either character cancels the stun early (see Character.takeHit()).

specialD.label: Bubble Bomb
specialD._note: Real MUGEN Statedef 1230 (shares SpongeBob's own 'blow a bubble' windup anim 1200, but branches into a genuine lobbed Projectile controller) - projanim 1203 is a real flying-bomb sprite (group 1300,6), projhitanim 1007 (the real explosion) isn't in this character's own .air (likely meant to come from a shared common-fx file we don't have), so hitSparkAction reuses the real local 8224 spark family instead; missSparkAction 8510 is this move's own real 'remove' fizzle spark (genuinely local, 10 frames). offsetX/offsetY are the real Projectile controller's own 'offset = 25,-55' (raw sprite-pixel units, scaled by the shooter's own render scale in the engine - see Projectile constructor).

summons.note: Companion assist-summons - Sandy/Squidward share the shared-companion attack anim (25002), Mr. Krabs has his own (1340). All three share the same 'appear' animation (1300) - verified real: states 1310/1320 both resolve anim=1300 too, i.e. the source character itself reuses one shared entrance pose. Rendered from Spongebob's OWN atlas (no separate sprite sheet needed) - see the engine's CompanionSummon class.

commandMoves.note: Motion-input 'combo' specials, faithful to Spongebob.cmd's real quarter-circle commands (D,DF,F / D,DB,B) but remapped from MUGEN's 6-button x/y/z/a/b/c onto this engine's 4-tier light/medium/heavy/special buttons. Recognized by the engine's CommandBuffer (see character.js) off the same held-direction state driving tilts/smashes - works identically from keyboard (arrow/WASD directions) or the Xbox 360 stick/d-pad.

moves.label: Emit Large Tomato Sauce
moves._note: action 3000 is the real hyper's cinematic intro pose (screen flash/background swap/portrait zoom, hypers.cns Statedef 3000) - the actual damaging hitbox lives in a separate follow-up state (3005) not currently played by name here; works today because hit detection just uses whatever this action's own frames provide, but a faithful multi-phase hyper intro->attack sequence is a bigger separate feature, not done here.

moves.label: Patty Frisbee
moves._note: Real flying object per supers.cns Statedef 1400's Projectile controller (projanim 1401 - genuine 3-frame spinning frisbee, group 1440) with a real dedicated hit explosion (projhitanim 5555, genuine 7-frame local animation) rather than reusing a generic spark. offsetX/offsetY are the real Projectile controller's own 'offset = 63,-73' (raw sprite-pixel units, scaled by the shooter's own render scale in the engine - see Projectile constructor).
